defects.description: reconnect() only clears the connected flag and opens a new session without bus.off, so the previous session listener stays attached and keeps recording after a later disconnect.

trigger.input: import { EventEmitter } from "node:events"; import { RealtimeClient } from "./src/realtime.js"; const bus = new EventEmitter(); const rt = new RealtimeClient(bus); rt.connect(); rt.reconnect(); rt.disconnect(); bus.emit("message","late"); console.log(JSON.stringify({listeners:bus.listenerCount("message"), last:rt.last}));

defects.why_missed: The suite reconnects once and only asserts that a message still arrives, so it never counts the session listeners or checks that a reconnected-then-disconnected client stops recording.
